english: Basic Pokémon '''''V''''' in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在场上，双方场上'''基础'''宝可梦的「宝可梦{{V}}」的特性，全部消除。

english: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, Pokémon with a Rule Box in play ''(both yours and your opponent's)'' have no Abilities, except for Future Pokémon. ''(Pokémon'' '''''ex''''', ''Pokémon'' '''''V''''', ''etc. have Rule Boxes.)''
chinese: 只要这只宝可梦在战斗场上，双方场上的「{{拥有规则的宝可梦|拥有规则的宝可梦}}」（除「{{TCG|未来}}」宝可梦外）的特性，全部消除。
